description: This file contains a C# program that generates project link references for source files in a PDFsharp-based project, potentially to facilitate adding files as linked items in Visual Studio projects via code.

classes.name: Program
classes.description: A static class containing the Main method to generate link references for project files.

methods.name: Main
methods.description: The entry point of the program that scans specified source directories for C# files, constructs project reference lines in XML format for linking, and copies the result to the clipboard.
